checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: add a PubMed-linked evidence citation to the home far-check card

impact_assessment.risks: contract: small UI text change + test; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use an existing in-corpus PMID, add a failing-first test, run all suites and review the UI.
